summary: The diff implements authentication gating via a ProtectedRoute wrapper and updates /register to trigger Internet Identity login. The Quiz flow adds a setup step to choose question count and saves results via the existing saveQuizResults flow. Many pages add empty/error states with CTAs, but some quiz-specific acceptance details (exact question count generation and progress indicators) cannot be fully verified from the truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Starting the quiz generates/renders exactly the selected number of questions (no more, no fewer), and the UI reflects that count in “Question X of Y” and the progress bar calculation.
missing_requirements.reason: QuizPage calls generateQuizQuestions(count), but the diff summary truncates frontend/src/utils/quiz.ts and the remainder of QuizPage, so it is not possible to confirm from provided evidence that question generation always returns exactly the requested count and that the progress UI explicitly uses “Question X of Y” and correct progress bar math.
